units.source_text: 结婚第三日之夜，自二公主的母舅大藏卿开始，以至向来照拂二公主的许多人，都受封赠为家臣。

en.t: On the night of the third day after the marriage, beginning with the Second Princess's maternal uncle, the Minister of the Treasury, many of those who had long cared for her were granted appointments as retainers.

units.source_text: 又非公开地犒赏薰大将的前驱、随身、车副、舍人等。

en.t: Private rewards were also given to General Kaoru's outriders, attendants, carriage aides, pages, and others.

units.source_text: 此种细节，均照普通臣民人家办法。

en.t: Such details were all handled according to the customs of ordinary noble households.

units.source_text: 自此以后，薰大将每天悄悄地到二公主房中住宿。

en.t: From then on, General Kaoru quietly went each day to spend the night in the Second Princess's rooms.

units.source_text: 但他心中，还是时刻想念那个难于忘却的宇治大女公子。

en.t: Yet in his heart he was still constantly thinking of that unforgettable elder lady of Uji.

units.source_text: 他白天在私邸内或起或卧，无时不沉思冥想。

en.t: By day, whether sitting up or lying down in his private residence, he was always sunk in brooding thought.

units.source_text: 到了日暮，没精打采地赴藤壶院去。

en.t: When evening came, he went listlessly to the Fujitsubo residence.

units.source_text: 他不习惯此种生涯，颇感苦痛，便计划将二公主接到私邸来住。

en.t: Unused to such a way of life and finding it deeply painful, he planned to bring the Second Princess to live at his private residence.

units.source_text: 母亲三公主闻之，不胜欣喜，情愿将自己所住正殿让与二公主住。

en.t: When his mother, the Third Princess, heard this, she was overjoyed and willingly offered to give the main hall where she lived to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 薰大将答道：“如此决不敢当！”

en.t: General Kaoru replied, "I could never presume to accept such a thing!"

units.source_text: 便在西面新筑殿宇，造一走廊通向佛堂，意欲请母亲转居西面。

en.t: He therefore had new buildings constructed on the western side and built a corridor leading to the Buddhist hall, intending to ask his mother to move westward.

units.source_text: 东所前年失火之后，早已重建，富丽堂皇，轩敞宜人。

en.t: After the fire of the previous year, the eastern quarters had already been rebuilt, splendidly appointed, spacious, and pleasant.

units.source_text: 此次更添修饰，详加设备。

en.t: This time they were further embellished and carefully furnished in every detail.

units.source_text: 薰大将这计划，今上也闻知了。

en.t: The reigning Emperor also heard of this plan of General Kaoru's.

units.source_text: 他想：“结婚未久，就毫无顾虑地移居私邸，是否妥当？”

en.t: He wondered, "Is it proper for her to move to a private residence so soon after the marriage, with no reserve at all?"

units.source_text: 然而，虽曰帝皇，父母爱子之心的昏蒙，原是同众人一样的。

en.t: And yet, even for an emperor, the blindness of a parent's love for a child is much the same as it is for everyone else.

units.source_text: 他遣使送给三公主的信上，所谈的净是二公主之事。

en.t: In the letter he sent to the Third Princess by messenger, he spoke of nothing but matters concerning the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 已故朱雀院曾把这位尼僧三公主郑重托付今上照拂。

en.t: The late Suzaku Emperor had once solemnly entrusted this nun, the Third Princess, to the present Emperor's care.

units.source_text: 所以三公主虽已出家为尼，威望并不衰减，万事都同从前一样。

en.t: Thus, although the Third Princess had taken the vows and become a nun, her prestige had not declined, and everything remained as it had been before.

units.source_text: 凡三公主有所奏请，今上无不准许，可知圣眷深重。

en.t: Whenever the Third Princess made a request, the Emperor granted it without fail, showing how deeply he favored her.

units.source_text: 薰大将身受这两位尊贵人物的无限宠爱，可谓荣幸之至了。

en.t: For General Kaoru to receive boundless affection from these two exalted persons was surely the height of good fortune.

units.source_text: 然而不知怎的，他心中并不特别欣喜，还是动辄沉思冥想。

en.t: Yet somehow his heart felt no particular joy, and he was still prone to sink into brooding thought at every turn.

units.source_text: 他只管操心于宇治建造佛寺的工事，盼望其早日落成。

en.t: He concerned himself only with the construction of the Buddhist temple at Uji, hoping it would be completed as soon as possible.
